commits.message: run the install step from lab/, where requirements.txt is not
commits.author: cipoklean

files.patch:
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@ jobs:
         with:
           python-version: '3.11'
       - name: install
+        working-directory: lab
         run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
       - name: test
         run: python -m pytest -q
